_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. Buying with unsettled proceeds and selling again before settlement is a good-faith violation.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Enter the day-2 hold, not the overnight coin flip. An hour of survival is the evidence the gap is real.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Buy what has not moved yet in the chain. Chasing the leader after the run is the +8% day by definition.
A one-position account cannot survive catching it wrong. Let the flush finish.

candidatesNote: Every name was up 5-10% into the AMD print. Chase warning stands. Prices are stale - re-quote before acting.

candidates.note: BMO print gaps past every stop. Window closes 8/6 close.
